user.description: Entities from Victron GX or Victron MQTT are filled in when one clear match exists. Ambiguous fields remain blank. Check every selection. DANGER — USE ENTIRELY AT YOUR OWN RISK. Writes remain locked until separately acknowledged and enabled.

init.title: System limits
init.description: DANGER — USE ENTIRELY AT YOUR OWN RISK. This integration can write to battery and inverter controls. Wrong entities or limits can damage equipment, interrupt power, or breach grid limits. Confirm every entity and electrical limit with a qualified installer. Verification allowances are added to each selected number entity's advertised step; leave them at zero unless its feedback requires more. Risk acknowledgement only unlocks the separate Allow Victron writes switch.
